title: Listening Drill — Sailing theory class — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Sailing theory class — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on sailing theory class last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with conflicting signals. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: damaged flag.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of marker colour so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow route plan instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the sailing coach before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Saturday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
